RawSourceAnnotationMetadata.description: Exact received metadata JSON retained as annotation evidence after the existing guarded JSON/IJSON check. This payload is not canonical physical metadata and does not attest origin or completeness. Partial/empty fields, unknown object members and other JSON shapes remain exact received evidence only.

semantic_guard: Existing strict guarded JSON rejects nonfinite values, unsupported JS values, unsafe integers, malformedUnicode/cycles/nonplainobjects before hashing. Annotation JSON presence alone never passes canonical metadata completeness or finite enum gates. Known contradiction units/components still block; missing required review metadata discloses.
metadata_absence_note: Prior annotations represent absent metadata as null while original received row hash/pointer retains exact original field presence. If explicit absent-vs-null annotation proof is required, a separate metadata_present boolean may be considered after complete reviewer return; no new absence-field contract is asserted by this fragment.
scope_limit: Annotation syntax only; no physical vocabulary, solver policy, producer DTO, source fence, Current gate, historical bytes, persistence, transport or runtime expansion.
